notes.key_messages:
• Numerical questions usually require the use of a formula. Candidates are advised to begin their
answer by writing down the formula without rearrangement. This avoids the possibility of an error in
the rearrangement of the formula or the use of wrong numbers.
• If candidates are required to define a quantity, e.g. acceleration, candidates should ensure they give
a precise statement in words or a formula with its symbols explained as required.
notes.general_comments:
The strongest candidates showed great consistency over most aspects of the paper. A large proportion of
other candidates showed strength in some questions on the paper but showed a lack of consistency. A small
proportion of candidates were weak in all questions on the paper.
